content:
As someone with both a bachelor’s and a master’s degree in marketing, I can only confirm.
Way too many people in corporate have an opinion on marketing.

 

Let the marketing professionals do their jobs, just as you let your lawyer do theirs.
headline: Let marketing pros do their jobs, like lawyers do theirs
description: With marketing degrees, I have seen too many corporate voices weigh in on marketing. Let marketing pros do their jobs, as you let lawyers do theirs.
